newsitem.title: USA: Colgate-Palmolive to sell Total in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Colgate-Palmolive to sell Total in U.S.

text.p: Colgate-Palmolive Co said Monday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved its Total Toothpaste for sale in the U.S.

The company said Total contains ingredients that have clinically demonstrated that it can help reduce cavities, gingivitis and plaque, and that no other toothpaste made in the U.S. has been approved to make claims for gingivitis and plaque reduction.

Colgate-Palmolive said it will begin selling Total in the U.S. within the next six months. It was introduced internationally in 1992 and is now in use in 103 countries, said the company, having sold 500,000,000 tubes.
